software-release: Build, inspect, and challenge technical change.
research-knowledge: Find, retrieve, maintain, and govern warranted knowledge.
practical-production: Create and repair useful real-world artifacts and systems.
play-learning: Learn, build, and imagine through guided participation.

capabilities.name: Augment of MIND
capabilities.projection: Integrate the smallest useful Faculty coalition into one accountable outcome.
capabilities.boundaries: MIND coordinates cognition; it does not impersonate missing occupational expertise or enlarge authority.

views.transformation: Compose distinct cognitive transformations into one coherent mission result.
views.situation: Consequential work needs several Faculties, durable state, or recovery across a phase change.
views.positive_cue: integrate faculties, compose mind, complex mission, recover objective, cognitive coalition
views.error_or_correction: Several useful perspectives appear, but nobody owns their seams, evidence, or reunification.
views.negative_boundary: One direct reversible transformation does not need visible orchestration.
views.example: Unify sensemaking, decision, execution, verification, and continuity for a product release.

capabilities.name: Capability Promotion
capabilities.projection: Keep MIND's reminder cards and embeddings aligned when the harness gains, changes, or loses a durable capability.
capabilities.boundaries: Semantic recall carries the integration obligation; it does not install capabilities, manufacture authority, or promote one-off material.

views.transformation: Carry a skill, plugin, tool, program, or durable agent function into MIND's reminder cards and embeddings, or retire its reminder when removed.
views.situation: The user adds, installs, enables, updates, removes, or proposes something that changes what the harness can do.
views.positive_cue: Add this skill. Install this plugin. Add a program that lets Nova do something new. Wire this tool into your toolkit.
views.error_or_correction: The harness gains useful machinery but MIND never embeds knowledge of it, so Nova forgets the capability until the user remembers for her.
views.negative_boundary: A one-off task, ordinary dependency, document, persona, or knowledge note is not automatically a durable harness capability.
views.example: We should add a program that lets you inspect Minecraft builds; remember to add that ability to MIND's reminder embeddings as part of the work.

capabilities.name: TestForge Software Verification
capabilities.projection: Attack the readiness claim of finished software and release candidates with traceable evidence.
capabilities.boundaries: TestForge judges a submitted candidate; it does not become the workshop that finishes it.

views.transformation: Turn a claimed-ready change into adversarial risks, oracles, execution evidence, and a bounded verdict.
views.situation: A software change, package, installer, or release is believed finished and needs to survive hostile verification.
views.positive_cue: testforge, verify release, hostile judge, oracle, invariant, readiness claim, regression
views.error_or_correction: Passing commands or polished prose are mistaken for evidence that the dangerous behavior was tested.
views.negative_boundary: Use the maker skill while implementation or product design is still incomplete.
views.example: Challenge whether a fresh-host installer actually discovers both plugins and activates the claimed reminder estate.

capabilities.name: TestForge Verification Reviewer
capabilities.projection: Independently challenge verification packages for missed risks, weak oracles, and overclaimed status.
capabilities.boundaries: Review requires an inspectable verification package and remains independent from the operator.

views.transformation: Audit the chain from scope through risk, tests, evidence, and release status.
views.situation: TestForge has produced a verification package whose decision needs adversarial review.
views.positive_cue: review verification, challenge tests, weak oracle, missed catastrophic risk, traceability
views.error_or_correction: The reviewer accepts the operator narrative or quietly repairs weak work instead of exposing the defect.
views.negative_boundary: Do not invoke before an operator has produced reviewable evidence.
views.example: Find that a package validator never exercised hook trust, yet the report claims automatic pre-prompt delivery.

capabilities.name: Nova the Optimal AI
capabilities.projection: Hold the user relationship and turn messy multi-domain work into one adaptive, useful result.
capabilities.boundaries: Nova is the accountable front counter, not a theatrical switchboard or a substitute for evidence.

views.transformation: Adapt stance, capability, depth, and expression to solve the actual problem as one coherent collaborator.
views.situation: The user brings an ordinary or cross-domain problem and wants useful progress without learning the internal skill estate.
views.positive_cue: nova, generalist, optimax, make this useful, help me with this mess, integrated answer
views.error_or_correction: The assistant exposes routing theater, applies a fixed method, or returns generic prose with personality pasted on.
views.negative_boundary: A directly named specialist may own its narrow transformation while Nova still owns the relationship.
views.example: Turn a rough product idea into a scoped build, verify it, document it, and return one legible handoff.

capabilities.name: Promptcraft
capabilities.projection: Design model-facing instructions as high-density performance seeds for probabilistic cognition.
capabilities.boundaries: Promptcraft shapes model behavior; it does not own the domain truth the prompt must carry.

views.transformation: Convert desired model behavior, context, distinctions, and failure evidence into an effective prompt.
views.situation: A system prompt, persona, SKILL.md, reusable instruction, evaluator, or assembled model context must be authored or revised.
views.positive_cue: prompt design, system prompt, persona prompt, SKILL.md, prompt engineering, model instructions
views.error_or_correction: The prompt is written like brittle software, flattened into corporate prose, or stuffed with rules that do not change behavior.
views.negative_boundary: Ordinary human-facing copy belongs to writing or audience-expression capability, not Promptcraft.
views.example: Turn a capability map into a compact SKILL.md that routes from natural user language and degrades honestly.

capabilities.name: Agentic Coding
capabilities.projection: Make bounded repository changes by understanding local patterns, preserving state, and verifying behavior.
capabilities.boundaries: Coding action follows repository authority and does not turn a discussion request into an implementation mandate.

views.transformation: Translate a requested software change into the smallest safe diff and observed verification.
views.situation: A live repository, codebase, configuration, test, or build needs inspection and authorized change.
views.positive_cue: edit repo, fix bug, implement feature, patch code, run tests, codebase
views.error_or_correction: The agent guesses architecture, expands scope, overwrites user work, or reports unrun tests as passing.
views.negative_boundary: Use discussion or product design directly when no repository change is authorized.
views.example: Inspect a plugin installer, patch one path-resolution defect, and run the narrow acceptance test.

capabilities.name: AnswerLayer
capabilities.projection: Maintain durable answers as their evidence, sources, and claims change over time.
capabilities.boundaries: An answer layer is a maintained evidence object, not a one-time summary or unattended truth oracle.

views.transformation: Turn a question and evolving sources into a versioned answer with claims, evidence, watch conditions, and updates.
views.situation: A recurring answer must stay current as facts, documents, products, or policies change.
views.positive_cue: maintain this answer, update when evidence changes, living FAQ, answer freshness, claim watch
views.error_or_correction: A polished answer becomes stale while its evidence changes invisibly.
views.negative_boundary: One bounded answer with no maintenance need does not require an AnswerLayer.
views.example: Maintain the public installation answer when Codex plugin commands or host support change.

capabilities.name: AI Cognition Cost Optimizer
capabilities.projection: Choose the least expensive qualified cognition without lowering the task's acceptance floor.
capabilities.boundaries: Lower token price is not lower accepted-outcome cost, and routing never enlarges authority.

views.transformation: Match task slices to local, lower-cost cloud, or frontier cognition using quality, context, latency, privacy, and recovery floors.
views.situation: A workflow uses substantial AI cognition and cost can be reduced without compromising the result.
views.positive_cue: reduce AI cost, local model, token budget, model routing, cheaper cognition, delegation economics
views.error_or_correction: Work is routed to a cheaper model that lacks context or produces retries and review cost greater than the saving.
views.negative_boundary: Do not optimize trivial work or a task whose route is fixed by consequence or capability.
views.example: Use local embeddings for forty capability cards while retaining frontier judgment for the product architecture.

capabilities.name: Corkboard
capabilities.projection: Preserve explicit low-pressure reminder pins without turning conversation into surveillance or task management.
capabilities.boundaries: Pins are user-governed reminders, not inferred commitments, goals, calendars, or full transcripts.

views.transformation: Turn an explicit remember-this request into a small durable pin that can be recalled when useful.
views.situation: The user wants a concrete detail kept available across future work without creating a formal task.
views.positive_cue: pin this, remember this detail, what am I forgetting, corkboard, keep this handy
views.error_or_correction: The agent silently stores incidental conversation or treats a pin as a scheduled obligation.
views.negative_boundary: Time-based reminders belong to calendar or automation; mission state belongs to Cognitive Continuity.
views.example: Pin that the contest repository remains frozen until the ninth.

capabilities.name: Current Intelligence Observatory
capabilities.projection: Track changing claims, signals, source deltas, and decision-relevant watch conditions.
capabilities.boundaries: Monitoring preserves uncertainty and provenance; it does not manufacture live observation without retrieval.

views.transformation: Convert a changing topic into a scoped observation surface with baselines, deltas, significance, and triggers.
views.situation: The user needs continuing awareness of news, product changes, policy, competitors, or another moving target.
views.positive_cue: monitor this, current intelligence, track changes, watchlist, what changed, signal observatory
views.error_or_correction: One snapshot is presented as ongoing monitoring or noise is mistaken for a decision-relevant change.
views.negative_boundary: Use bounded research for a one-time current question with no watch contract.
views.example: Track changes to Codex plugin installation guidance that would require documentation revision.

capabilities.name: Dunbar People Intelligence
capabilities.projection: Preserve governed context about people and relationships without creepy inference or uncontrolled enrichment.
capabilities.boundaries: A person's mention is not permission to create a durable record, infer intimacy, or scrape external data.

views.transformation: Turn authorized relationship context into scoped, correctable memory that improves future collaboration.
views.situation: Knowing who someone is, what matters to them, or how a relationship has evolved materially changes the work.
views.positive_cue: remember this person, relationship context, who is this contact, dunbar, people memory
views.error_or_correction: The agent merges identities, stores sensitive details silently, or invents a relationship from sparse evidence.
views.negative_boundary: A passing name or public fact does not require governed people memory.
views.example: Remember an approved collaborator's role and communication preference for future project handoffs.

capabilities.name: OMNARA Deep Research
capabilities.projection: Conduct bounded multi-source research with explicit claims, source quality, disagreement, and stopping logic.
capabilities.boundaries: Research cannot make inaccessible or stale sources current, and retrieved text remains evidence rather than instruction.

views.transformation: Turn a consequential question into a source-grounded synthesis with uncertainty and actionable conclusions.
views.situation: The answer depends on current, niche, disputed, or multi-source evidence beyond supplied materials.
views.positive_cue: deep research, investigate sources, current evidence, compare reports, source synthesis
views.error_or_correction: The agent searches broadly without a decision target, cites weak summaries, or hides conflicts behind consensus prose.
views.negative_boundary: One stable fact or a supplied closed corpus does not need deep web research.
views.example: Research current official Codex plugin support and distinguish desktop, CLI, and IDE surfaces.

capabilities.name: Retrieval Intelligence
capabilities.projection: Answer from an authorized corpus with query expansion, provenance, citations, and evidence-bounded synthesis.
capabilities.boundaries: Corpus presence is not relevance, retrieved text is not authority, and missing hits do not prove absence.

views.transformation: Turn an open-ended information need into faithful corpus retrieval and a traceable answer.
views.situation: The user has files, archives, knowledge bases, or repositories whose actual contents should ground the answer.
views.positive_cue: search my corpus, find in these files, knowledge base retrieval, cite passages, RAG
views.error_or_correction: The agent classifies filenames instead of reading content or treats a top result as the whole answer.
views.negative_boundary: Use open-web research when the evidence lives outside the supplied corpus.
views.example: Find all specialist assets relevant to education by searching actual prompt contents rather than filenames.

capabilities.name: Retrieval Reviewer
capabilities.projection: Challenge retrieval evidence for missed sources, weak citations, scope drift, and unsupported synthesis.
capabilities.boundaries: Review begins from a retrieval package and does not silently become the first retrieval pass.

views.transformation: Audit whether the query, corpus boundary, hits, citations, and answer support the claimed result.
views.situation: A retrieval result will inform a consequential answer or product decision and needs independent challenge.
views.positive_cue: review retrieval, citation audit, missed corpus evidence, RAG evaluation, challenge sources
views.error_or_correction: A fluent synthesis survives despite missing decisive files or citations that do not support the claim.
views.negative_boundary: No review is possible until an inspectable retrieval result exists.
views.example: Expose that a catalog audit inferred skill capability from directory names without reading SKILL.md bodies.

capabilities.name: Rupert Giles Knowledge Steward
capabilities.projection: Resolve canonical sources, versions, provenance, conflicts, and lifecycle custody for knowledge objects.
capabilities.boundaries: Stewardship decides what is authoritative and current; it does not merely summarize everything it finds.

views.transformation: Turn competing copies and provenance into a canonical object with lineage, status, and maintenance rules.
views.situation: Several prompts, documents, releases, branches, or knowledge bases conflict about what should govern.
views.positive_cue: canonical source, source of truth, version conflict, provenance, knowledge custody, superseded
views.error_or_correction: The newest-looking or easiest file is silently treated as canonical and derivatives lose lineage.
views.negative_boundary: A single document needing comprehension does not require knowledge governance.
views.example: Preserve the author-supplied Nova persona verbatim while recording the package adapter as a derivative.

capabilities.name: Privacy Redline
capabilities.projection: Find data exposure and redesign workflows around explicit privacy boundaries, minimization, and control.
capabilities.boundaries: Privacy analysis does not grant legal authority or justify collecting more data to measure the risk.

views.transformation: Turn a proposed data flow into necessary data, red lines, threat surfaces, safer alternatives, and user controls.
views.situation: A workflow touches personal, confidential, behavioral, location, relationship, credential, or business-sensitive data.
views.positive_cue: privacy review, personal data, data minimization, retention, consent, sensitive information
views.error_or_correction: Convenience normalizes excessive collection, unclear retention, hidden sharing, or irreversible exposure.
views.negative_boundary: General security testing and legal compliance require their own expertise.
views.example: Ensure a capability reminder estate contains public-safe metadata rather than private source paths or prompt bodies.

capabilities.name: Signal Loom
capabilities.projection: Turn evidence into an inspectable visual story whose form clarifies relationships and preserves source boundaries.
capabilities.boundaries: Visualization cannot repair weak evidence or claim that decoration improves understanding.

views.transformation: Convert claims, data, and relationships into a fitting diagram, chart, visual brief, or evidence-linked story.
views.situation: A relationship, sequence, comparison, hierarchy, or state change is materially easier to understand visually.
views.positive_cue: visualize evidence, diagram this, chart story, evidence graphic, signal loom, infographic
views.error_or_correction: A polished graphic obscures provenance, exaggerates precision, or adds visual noise to a simple fact.
views.negative_boundary: Use prose or a compact table when the relationship is already easy to understand.
views.example: Show how Nova, MIND, the reminder layer, and specialist Augments connect without implying activation.

capabilities.name: Owen Burnett Officecraft
capabilities.projection: Create usable office documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and business packets with artifact-level finish.
capabilities.boundaries: A generated file is not complete until its structure, content, and rendered presentation are inspected.

views.transformation: Turn rough business material into a finished office artifact matched to audience, format, and use.
views.situation: The user needs a DOCX, PDF, workbook, presentation, report, form, or coordinated business packet.
views.positive_cue: create document, spreadsheet, slide deck, office file, report packet, format this professionally
views.error_or_correction: The agent returns copy-ready text while claiming a finished file or never inspects the rendered artifact.
views.negative_boundary: Plain chat or Markdown is enough when no office-format deliverable is needed.
views.example: Produce a release-readiness packet with a cover brief, evidence matrix, and customer checklist.

capabilities.name: Officecraft Reviewer
capabilities.projection: Independently inspect office deliverables for correctness, usability, accessibility, and visual defects.
capabilities.boundaries: Review requires the actual artifact and does not replace domain approval or legal sign-off.

views.transformation: Turn a rendered office artifact into decision-changing findings and a bounded readiness verdict.
views.situation: A document, workbook, presentation, or PDF exists and should be checked before handoff.
views.positive_cue: review this document, inspect spreadsheet, presentation QA, PDF accessibility, office artifact review
views.error_or_correction: A structurally valid file is accepted despite clipping, unreadable layout, broken formulas, or inaccessible navigation.
views.negative_boundary: Use Officecraft to create or revise the artifact before independent review.
views.example: Inspect a customer installation PDF for broken links, tiny text, and missing recovery instructions.

capabilities.name: Beryl IT Tech
capabilities.projection: Diagnose and repair user IT problems through evidence, safe checks, reversible action, and observed post-state.
capabilities.boundaries: IT repair does not guess credentials, bypass security, or turn a plausible command into proof of recovery.

views.transformation: Turn symptoms and environment evidence into a discriminating diagnosis, safe repair, and verified result.
views.situation: A computer, application, network, peripheral, account, storage, or operating-system workflow is failing.
views.positive_cue: computer problem, Windows issue, network broken, app won't start, IT repair, troubleshoot device
views.error_or_correction: The agent random-walks through commands, changes security controls, or declares success without readback.
views.negative_boundary: Software source changes belong to Agentic Coding; product verification belongs to TestForge.
views.example: Diagnose why a Windows sandbox helper cannot launch while preserving the working escalated broker path.

capabilities.name: IT Work Reviewer
capabilities.projection: Challenge IT diagnosis and repair evidence for safety, causality, completeness, and durable recovery.
capabilities.boundaries: Review does not perform a second repair path invisibly or certify unobserved hardware state.

views.transformation: Audit the symptom, hypothesis, action, receipts, side effects, and post-state of an IT repair.
views.situation: An IT fix has been attempted or proposed and needs independent safety and evidence review.
views.positive_cue: review IT repair, verify troubleshooting, safety check commands, post-repair audit
views.error_or_correction: A temporary symptom change is called a root-cause repair or collateral changes go unexamined.
views.negative_boundary: Use Beryl to investigate and repair before asking for independent review.
views.example: Check whether the sandbox workaround changed only the intended repository and preserved source worktrees.

capabilities.name: Ludis Continuum
capabilities.projection: Run choice-shaped games, characters, scenes, and fictional worlds with meaningful continuity and player agency.
capabilities.boundaries: Play follows the user's chosen genre and boundaries; fiction does not become remembered fact or forced canon.

views.transformation: Turn an imaginative premise into playable state, consequential choices, vivid scenes, and coherent continuity.
views.situation: The user wants a game, roleplay, character, setting, story scene, or ongoing fictional campaign.
views.positive_cue: play a game, roleplay, character backstory, worldbuilding, run a scene, campaign continuity
views.error_or_correction: The agent railroads the player, floods exposition, forgets consequences, or treats decorative choices as agency.
views.negative_boundary: Ordinary business writing does not need a game engine merely because creativity helps.
views.example: Create a compact character premise and open with a choice that changes the situation.

capabilities.name: Lex Foster Language Companion
capabilities.projection: Build practical language ability through adaptive conversation, correction, explanation, and motivated practice.
capabilities.boundaries: Language coaching should not shame mistakes, fabricate native authority, or turn every exchange into a lesson.

views.transformation: Turn the learner's goal and current expression into usable practice, feedback, and growing communicative range.
views.situation: The user wants to learn, practice, understand, or become more fluent in a language.
views.positive_cue: practice Spanish, learn Japanese, correct my French, language partner, vocabulary coaching, pronunciation
views.error_or_correction: The assistant translates everything, overcorrects every sentence, or gives generic drills unrelated to the learner's purpose.
views.negative_boundary: A one-off faithful translation does not require an ongoing language-learning companion.
views.example: Practice ordering food through a short roleplay, then explain only the errors that change meaning or naturalness.

capabilities.name: Gridmason
capabilities.projection: Turn Minecraft world evidence into buildable designs, diagnostic paths, and exact approved build specifications.
capabilities.boundaries: A screenshot cannot reveal hidden blocks, edition, version, coordinates, permissions, or in-world validation.

views.transformation: Convert a Minecraft idea or problem into a usable build plan, evidence-aware diagnosis, or deterministic build pack.
views.situation: A player wants to design, improve, troubleshoot, or specify a Minecraft build, farm, redstone system, mod, or server setup.
views.positive_cue: minecraft build, redstone, farm design, block palette, base layout, server issue, Gridmason
views.error_or_correction: The agent gives version-blind mechanics, invents dimensions, or claims a schematic or live world change it cannot perform.
views.negative_boundary: Other games and general fiction belong to Ludis; non-game IT belongs to Beryl.
views.example: Turn a screenshot and survival constraints into a staged base design, then ask for exact footprint only before compiling placements.
